title: Statistical analysis code for repeated digestive disease–depressive symptom co-occurrence and functional transitions in CHARLS
description: Statistical analysis code for a longitudinal CHARLS study of time-varying digestive disease–depressive symptom states; repeated and cumulative co-occurrence histories; and transitions among no functional limitation, IADL limitation, ADL limitation, and death. No participant-level CHARLS data, manuscripts, analysis outputs, or author contact information are included.
